intro: The Stolen Silver is a recovered strongbox of Horde coin meant for the Crossroads guard garrison. It was bizarrely carried off into the wilderness by the ferocious raptors of the Barrens, leading to disbelief among the outpost's overseers.

p: The vast wilds of the Barrens present constant threats to supply lines, but few expected the local Sunscale raptors to target strongboxes of metal currency. When a shipment carrying payroll for the Crossroads garrison was intercepted, the raptors dragged the lockbox back to their communal nests at the Raptor Grounds south of Ratchet. To overseers like Gazrog, the theft reveals an unsettling degree of cunning in the predators, who apparently value shiny trinkets or possess intelligence far beyond that of ordinary wild beasts.
